products.title: Arduino Uno R3 development board
products.description: A versatile ATmega328P development board for learning electronics, automation and embedded programming.

products.title: ESP32 Wi-Fi + Bluetooth development board
products.description: Connect your sensors to the cloud. A Wi-Fi and Bluetooth board for dashboards, monitoring and connected projects.

products.title: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor
products.description: Measure distance for obstacle avoidance, water-level monitoring and introductory robotics.

products.title: Desktop robotic arm learning kit
products.description: Explore motion control, pick-and-place sequences and robotic automation in your lab.

products.title: FDM 3D printer — learning lab edition
products.description: Bring CAD designs into the physical world with an FDM printer for educational prototyping.

products.title: Drone technology exploration kit
products.description: An introduction to flight systems, sensing and aerial robotics. Specifications are illustrative for this demo.

projects.title: Smart irrigation & soil monitoring
projects.description: A connected irrigation system that waters plants when they need it, with live sensor readings.
projects.applications: Agricultural monitoring, college demonstrations and connected greenhouse prototypes.
projects.how: Sensors measure soil conditions. The ESP32 compares readings with a threshold and activates irrigation. A dashboard displays readings and pump status.

projects.title: Vision-guided pick & place robot
projects.description: Teach a robotic arm to identify, sort and move objects through a repeatable control sequence.
projects.applications: Automation labs, industrial research and final-year engineering demonstrations.
projects.how: A vision system identifies objects. Software estimates a target position and sends motion commands to the arm. Gripper feedback confirms the transfer.

projects.title: Obstacle-avoiding autonomous robot
projects.description: Build your first mobile robot and learn how sensors turn measurements into decisions.
projects.applications: School science exhibitions, STEM workshops and introductory embedded systems labs.
projects.how: The ultrasonic sensor measures distance ahead. The controller stops or turns the motors when an obstacle is detected, then resumes forward travel.

projects.title: AI-assisted visual inspection system
projects.description: Explore computer vision with a prototype that classifies visible defects in sample components.
projects.applications: CSE final-year projects, machine vision research and manufacturing demonstrations.
projects.how: A camera captures an image. A trained model classifies the sample, and a dashboard shows the prediction for human review.

projects.title: 3D-printed adaptive robotic gripper
projects.description: Design, print and test a gripper mechanism for small-object handling.
projects.applications: Mechanical design, rapid prototyping and robotics research.
projects.how: A CAD model defines the linkage. Printed parts are assembled with an actuator, then grip range and repeatability are tested.

projects.title: Industrial condition monitoring
projects.description: Monitor equipment signals and explore alerts, trends and preventive maintenance dashboards.
projects.applications: Industrial IoT demonstrations, instrumentation labs and engineering prototypes.
projects.how: Connected sensors capture equipment signals. Measurements are sent to a dashboard where configurable thresholds highlight abnormal conditions.
